subject: [PATCH 08/60] mm/migrate: reject move_pages() destinations outside common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a new check for N_MEMORY_COMMON in the move_pages() function to reject destinations outside common memory. This change is intended to align with existing memory policies and prevent potential issues.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series modifies the move_pages() function to reject destinations outside common memory, aligning it with existing memory policies.
